description:
The Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY) is a housing scheme initiated by the Government of India. 

It aims to provide affordable housing to the urban poor. 

The objective is to ensure that every family has a pucca house with basic amenities. 

The scheme offers financial assistance for the construction or purchase of houses. 

It also provides interest subsidies on home loans. 

Eligible beneficiaries include Economically Weaker Sections (EWS) Low Income Groups (LIG) and Middle Income Groups (MIG). 

Applicants must have a valid Aadhaar number and must not own a house in their name. 

The application process can be completed online through the PMAY website or through Common Service Centers. 

The scheme is implemented in a phased manner with a target to complete housing by 2022. 

The Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs is the nodal agency for implementation. 

The scheme also includes provisions for slum rehabilitation and the development of affordable housing projects. 

The financial assistance varies based on the category of the beneficiaries and the location of the house. 

The scheme promotes the use of green technology and sustainable building materials. 

Beneficiaries can avail of the scheme through the Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS). 

The scheme is part of the larger initiative to achieve Housing for All by 2022.
